description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies a string pattern used when creating a Profile or ODFC container folder. Use this setting to define how FSLogix will attempt to create a users Profile or ODFC container folder. FSLogix will use the VHDLocations or CCDLocations as the location where to create and this setting defines what to create.

NOTE:  When using this configuration setting, be sure the SIDDIRNameMatch value matches this setting.

- This setting has NO EFFECT when FlipFlopProfileDirectoryName is enabled.
- This setting has NO EFFECT when NoProfileContainingFolder is enabled.
- NoProfileContainingFolder > FlipFlopProfileDirectoryName > SIDDirNamePattern (this setting)

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\SIDDirNamePattern
Type:  REG_SZ
